outputs.explanation: Panel A contains a schematic (breast anatomy) and a table (classification/frequencies), not a plot requiring individual data points.
Panel B is a schematic diagram illustrating the study aims, not a data plot.
Panel C is a schematic depicting the luciferase recording method, not a data plot.
Panel D shows illustrative line plots of circadian signals (schematic examples), which are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel E is a heatmap of correlation values; heatmaps are exempt from the individual data points requirement.
Panel F contains a schematic of the live-imaging setup and an illustrative line plot of cell growth over time; line plots are exempt.
Panel G contains a schematic of drug treatment and an illustrative dose-response line plot; line plots are exempt.
Panel H shows a schematic plus heatmap-style displays (gene expression heatmap and mutation grid); heatmaps are exempt.
Panel I shows scatter plots (PCA cluster plot and 3D parameter scatter plot); scatter plots inherently show individual data points and are exempt from the overlay requirement.
